chunks: And for that reason, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said:

key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family.
key_terms.بِعَمَّتِكُمْ: Your paternal aunt, used here metaphorically.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about the date palm?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله a saying about the date palm, expressed through the metaphor of a paternal aunt. It conveys a recommendation of good treatment and regard, framed in the language of kinship and respect.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5703 - For this reason (Hadith.5702), the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said
